worked.title: Q2 · Derivative of softmax + categorical cross-entropy

problem.text: Three classes, ŷₖ = e^{zₖ}/Σⱼe^{zⱼ}, L = −Σₖ yₖ log ŷₖ. Derive ∂L/∂zₖ.

steps.label: Softmax Jacobian
steps.text: ∂ŷᵢ/∂zₖ = ŷᵢ(δᵢₖ − ŷₖ): ŷₖ(1 − ŷₖ) if i = k, −ŷᵢŷₖ otherwise

steps.label: Sum over all outputs
steps.text: ∂L/∂zₖ = Σᵢ (−yᵢ/ŷᵢ) · ŷᵢ(δᵢₖ − ŷₖ) = −yₖ + ŷₖ Σᵢ yᵢ

steps.label: Common slip
steps.text: Stopping at −yₖ(1 − ŷₖ) keeps only the i = k term. That is right for the true class (ŷₖ − 1) but misses the cross terms for the other classes (it gives 0 instead of ŷₖ). The full result is ŷ − y.

worked.title: Q3 · MLP for a rectangle

problem.text: Output 1 inside the rectangle P(4, 6), Q(7, 6), R(7, 2), S(4, 2); 0 outside.

steps.label: Hidden units
steps.text: h₁: x₁ − 4 ≥ 0; h₂: 7 − x₁ ≥ 0; h₃: x₂ − 2 ≥ 0; h₄: 6 − x₂ ≥ 0 (step activations)

steps.label: Output
steps.text: AND of the four: h₁ + h₂ + h₃ + h₄ − 3.5 ≥ 0

worked.answer: 4 hidden half-plane units + 1 AND output (weights 1, bias −3.5).

steps.label: Minimum
steps.text: p* = −1.5, t* = 0; the gap shrinks by 1 − 0.8 = 0.2 per step

worked.title: Q5 · Sigmoid computational graph at z = 3
Q6 · Stationary point of E = (w₁ − w₂)³ − 2(w₁² − w₂) + w₁² + w₂²

problem.text: Find the minimising (w₁, w₂, w₃) and the minimum error.

steps.label: Solve
steps.text: Adding gives w₁ − w₂ = 1; then 3 = 2w₁ → **w₁ = 1.5, w₂ = 0.5**; w₃ is free (E doesn't depend on it)

steps.label: Caution
steps.text: The Hessian there is [[4, −6], [−6, 8]] with determinant −4 < 0, so it is a **saddle point**, and the cubic term makes E unbounded below. The expected answer is (1.5, 0.5, any) with E = 0; mention the saddle for full marks.

worked.answer: (1.5, 0.5, any w₃), E = 0 (a stationary point; strictly a saddle).
